description: This file implements a TestServer class and related functions for managing test execution, server control, and UI interactions within the Playwright testing framework. It includes server start/stop, test listing, running, and reporter integration.

classes.name: TestServer
classes.description: Manages starting and stopping the test server with configuration options.

classes.name: TestServerDispatcher
classes.description: Handles communication between the test runner and external clients, manages test execution, and server events.

methods.name: runUIMode
methods.description: Runs the test server in UI mode, opening trace viewer in browser or app.

methods.name: runTestServer
methods.description: Starts the test server and logs its URL, managing server lifecycle.

methods.name: innerRunTestServer
methods.description: Core function to initialize and run the test server with cleanup and signal handling.

methods.name: chunkToPayload
methods.description: Converts a Buffer or string chunk into a payload object for stdio interception.
